user.title: Connect to your GoodWe ETA inverter
user.description: Connect directly to the GoodWe ETA over Modbus TCP. Give the inverter a static IP address or DHCP reservation before continuing.

data_description.host: Fixed IP address of the GoodWe ETA inverter.

controller.title: Configure EnergyPilot and EMHASS
controller.description: EMHASS must already be installed, running and configured. Keep Automatic Control OFF until Optimize now completes successfully and publishes a numeric P_batt target.

data.p_batt_entity: EMHASS battery power target entity ID
data.emhass_soc_final_pct: Target SOC at end of optimization

data_description.p_batt_entity: Standard ID: sensor.p_batt_forecast. It can be entered before EMHASS creates the entity.
data_description.optim_status_entity: Standard ID: sensor.optim_status. It can be entered before EMHASS creates the entity.
data_description.optim_required_state: EnergyPilot executes P_batt only when this state matches. Standard: Optimal.
data_description.max_power_kw: Maximum charge or discharge request. Use 15.0 kW only when the inverter, battery and grid allow it.
data_description.deadband: Targets inside this range around 0 W become Battery Hold. Recommended: 300 W.
data_description.scan_interval: How often EnergyPilot polls the inverter. Recommended: 10 seconds.
data_description.enable_emhass_orchestrator: Runs optimization and publish independently from Automatic Control.
data_description.emhass_url: Default Home Assistant EMHASS add-on URL: http://5b918bf2-emhass:5000.
data_description.emhass_optimization_interval: Periodic fallback interval. Recommended: 60 minutes. Event triggers run immediately.
data_description.emhass_soc_final_pct: Runtime soc_final target. This does not replace the EMHASS minimum/maximum SOC limits.
data_description.emhass_fallback_load: Used only when live and historical house-load data are not plausible.
data_description.use_nordpool_prices: Uses nordpool.get_prices_for_date when available, otherwise a sensor with raw_today/raw_tomorrow. Disable this to use the price method configured inside EMHASS.
data_description.optimize_on_tomorrow_prices: Immediately creates a new plan when tomorrow prices become available.
data_description.nordpool_area: Optional market area such as NL. Leave empty to use the detected area/source.
data_description.buy_price_adder: Variable supplier fees, taxes or additions in EUR/kWh.
data_description.sell_price_deduction: Amount deducted from the market export price in EUR/kWh.
data_description.enable_ev_coordination: Holds the battery while EV charging is active and re-optimizes when charging stops.
data_description.ev_power_entity: Optional EV charging-power entity in watts.
data_description.ev_deadband: Power above this threshold is considered active EV charging.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the GoodWe ETA or read EMS registers 47511/47512. Verify IP address, port, Unit ID and Modbus TCP availability.

abort.already_configured: This GoodWe ETA inverter is already configured.
